$comment: Planner-role fusion output (unified-platform-spec.md §7.5, REQ-16.5). Dispatched BEFORE the task loop with panel input pinned to the frozen goal+ACs only — no file/repo context (there is no task graph to plan over in a single-task composition). Structural validation ONLY: no full planning gate exists in this composition, and the resolved plan is advisory — injected into the implementer round's context as MARKed data (core never parses free text; a plan is read, never executed directly). The embedded copy in console/backend/src/fusion.ts (PLAN_SCHEMA) MUST stay byte-equivalent in required-property SHAPE to this governance artifact (co-located test asserts it).

approach.description: One-paragraph synthesis of how the panel's candidates converged on a strategy.

steps.description: Ordered, advisory guidance for the implementer round — never an Action DSL, never executed directly.

risks.description: Known unknowns or blast-radius concerns the panel flagged, if any.
